name: GoAway
tagline: Lightweight DNS sinkhole for blocking ads and trackers
description: GoAway is a lightweight DNS sinkhole that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious domains at the network level. It provides a web-based admin dashboard for management and supports customizable blocking rules with real-time statistics tracking.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Services used in the application
services:
  # The `big-bear-goaway` service for the goaway application
  big-bear-goaway:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-goaway
    # Docker image to be used
    image: pommee/goaway:0.63.17@sha256:971efe3aca286accf2d2da24b28bac57354df29949f800d5c48134363c9533ac
    # Restart policy for the service
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Port mappings for the service
    ports:
      - "53:53/udp" # DNS port UDP
      - "53:53/tcp" # DNS port TCP
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080" # Web dashboard port
    # Network mode for the service
    network_mode: bridge
    # Volumes for the service HOST -> CONTAINER
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/app/config
    # Capabilities required for DNS services
    cap_add:
      - NET_BIND_SERVICE
      - NET_RAW
